title: 3人制バスケ「3x3.EXE PREMIER JAPAN 2026」男子開幕戦がワテラスで開催
summary: 3人制バスケットボールのプロリーグ「3x3.EXE PREMIER JAPAN 2026」男子ROUND.1開幕戦と女子ROUND.2が、2026年5月16日・17日にワテラスで開催。全試合観戦無料で、移動式遊び場やスポーツ体験会、キッチンカーも登場する。
content:
## 概要

3人制バスケットボールのグローバルプロリーグ「3x3.EXE PREMIER JAPAN 2026」の男子ROUND.1開幕戦と女子ROUND.2が、2026年5月16日・17日にワテラスで開催されます。会場は神田淡路町のワテラスで、両日11:00〜18:00の開催です。

男子開幕戦のワテラス開催は2022年から5年連続。男女両方の試合を同じ会場で無料観戦できるイベントとして案内されています。

## 内容

5月16日・17日は、男子ROUND.1と女子ROUND.2の試合がワテラスで行われます。公式サイトでは、タイムスケジュールと出場チーム情報が日別に案内され、MCは竹本タクシー、DJはDJ YOU MATSUZAKIが担当すると紹介されています。

会場では試合観戦に加え、周辺イベントも実施されます。5月16日13:00〜16:00には、ワテラスキッズ「移動式遊び場」として巨大コリント、ピタゴラ装置、打楽器、積み木などが登場。5月17日11:00〜16:00には東京ヴェルディクラブによるパルクール体験会とキック＆スローターゲット体験会も予定されています。どちらも参加費無料で、スポーツ体験会は雨天中止です。

観戦のお供としてキッチンカーも出店予定です。雨天の場合は会場が変更になる可能性があるため、当日の最新情報は3x3.EXE PREMIER公式サイトで確認してください。

en.content:
## Overview

The men's ROUND.1 opening game and women's ROUND.2 of the global 3x3 basketball pro league "3x3.EXE PREMIER JAPAN 2026" will be held at Waterras in Kanda Awajicho on May 16–17, 2026. Both days run from 11:00 to 18:00.

This marks the fifth consecutive year the men's opening round is held at Waterras (since 2022). Both men's and women's matches can be watched for free at the same venue.

## Highlights

On May 16 and 17, men's ROUND.1 and women's ROUND.2 matches will take place at Waterras. The official website provides daily schedules and participating team information. MC duties will be handled by Takemoto Taxi, with DJ YOU MATSUZAKI on the decks.

Along with the matches, surrounding events are also planned. On May 16 from 13:00–16:00, the Waterras Kids "Mobile Playground" event will feature a giant Korinto game, Rube Goldberg machines, percussion instruments, and building blocks. On May 17 from 11:00–16:00, Tokyo Verdy Club will host parkour experience sessions and a kick & throw target experience — both free, though the sports experiences will be cancelled in case of rain.

Food trucks will also be on-site to accompany the matches. In the event of rain, venues may change — check the 3x3.EXE PREMIER official website for the latest information on the day.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Waterras
- **Address**: 101, 105 Kanda Awajicho 2-chome, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo

- **Hours**: 11:00–18:00

- **Note**: Venue may change in case of rain

## Recommended For

- Those looking for free sporting events to enjoy
- Those who want to enjoy a children's playground and sports experiences alongside the games
- Those checking out weekend events around Waterras, Ochanomizu, and Akihabara

title: ものづくり館 by YKKでスマホポシェット作りワークショップ開催
summary: ものづくり館 by YKKで、ワークショップ「キラキラファスナーでスマホポシェットを作ろう」が2026年5月2日に開催。オーロライトとメタリックコイルを使い、2.5mのファスナーを縫い合わせてポシェットを作る。
content:
## 概要

ものづくり館 by YKKで、ワークショップ「キラキラファスナーでスマホポシェットを作ろう」が2026年5月2日に開催されます。時間は午前の部10:00〜11:30、午後の部13:00〜14:30です。

会場は秋葉原駅近くのYKK和泉ビル4階。参加費は1,800円（税込）で、各回定員6名の事前予約制です。PassMarketでは予定枚数終了と案内されています。

## 内容

キラキラファスナーを使って、スマートフォンを入れるのにちょうど良いサイズのポシェットを作るワークショップです。使用するファスナーは、エレメントがオーロラのように輝く「オーロライト」と、樹脂製ながら金属の輝きを持つメタリックコイルです。

長さ2.5mのファスナーを縫い合わせて本体を作り、提げヒモもファスナーで仕上げます。エレメントの色はゴールド、シルバー、カッパー、白、水色、パープルの6種類から選択可能。バッグ本体サイズはタテ約22cm×ヨコ約13cm、提げヒモの長さは調節できます。

ミシンを使用するため、参加対象は小学4年生以上です。小学生は保護者同伴で一緒に作製する必要があります。申し込み後は材料準備に入るためキャンセル不可と案内されています。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: ものづくり館 by YKK
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区神田和泉町1-1 YKK和泉ビル4F
- **日程**: 2026年5月2日
- **時間**: 午前の部 10:00〜11:30、午後の部 13:00〜14:30
- **定員**: 各回6名
- **参加費**: 1,800円（税込）
- **対象**: 小学4年生以上（小学生は保護者同伴）
- **申込方法**: PassMarket予約のみ、事前決済
- **申込締切**: 2026年4月24日 12:00
- **予約**: 必要（予定枚数終了）

## こんな人におすすめ

- ファスナーを使ったものづくりを体験したい方
- 秋葉原で親子参加できるワークショップを探している方
- スマホポシェットや手作り小物に興味がある方
- YKKのファスナー素材を使ったクラフトを楽しみたい方

en.title: [Akihabara] Smartphone Pochette-Making Workshop at Monodzukuri-kan by YKK
en.summary: A workshop titled "Let's Make a Smartphone Pochette with Sparkling Zippers!" will be held on May 2, 2026, at Monodzukuri-kan by YKK. Participants will sew 2.5 meters of zipper — using Aurora Light and metallic coil elements — to create a pochette.
en.content:
## Overview

The workshop "Let's Make a Smartphone Pochette with Sparkling Zippers!" will be held on May 2, 2026, at Monodzukuri-kan by YKK. Morning session: 10:00–11:30; Afternoon session: 13:00–14:30.

The venue is the 4th floor of YKK Izumi Building near Akihabara Station. The participation fee is ¥1,800 (tax included), with a limit of 6 participants per session on a reservation-only basis. Registration via PassMarket has been listed as closed.

## Highlights

Participants will use sparkling zippers to make a pochette perfectly sized for a smartphone. The zippers used include "Aurora Light" — with elements that shimmer like aurora — and metallic coil, a resin-based zipper that shines like metal.

Participants will sew together 2.5 meters of zipper to form the body and finish the strap with zipper as well. Element color options include gold, silver, copper, white, light blue, and purple (6 choices). The bag body size is approximately 22cm tall x 13cm wide, with an adjustable strap length.

Since the workshop uses a sewing machine, it is open to 4th grade elementary school students and above. Elementary school students must be accompanied by a guardian who will create together with them. Cancellations are not accepted once materials preparation has begun.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Monodzukuri-kan by YKK
- **Address**: 4F YKK Izumi Building, 1-1 Kanda Izumicho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Date**: May 2, 2026
- **Hours**: Morning 10:00–11:30 / Afternoon 13:00–14:30
- **Capacity**: 6 participants per session
- **Fee**: ¥1,800 (tax included)
- **Eligible**: 4th grade elementary school students and above (elementary students must be accompanied by a guardian)
- **Registration**: PassMarket only, advance payment required
- **Registration Deadline**: April 24, 2026, 12:00
- **Reservation**: Required (listed as closed)

## Recommended For

- Those who want to experience crafting with zippers
- Those looking for a parent-child workshop in Akihabara
- Those interested in smartphone pouches and handmade accessories
- Those who want to enjoy crafting with YKK zipper materials

en.title: [Akihabara] "Gintama Chara Pop Store" Held at Atre Akihabara Through November 23
en.summary: The "Gintama Chara Pop Store" is being held at Bandai Namco Cross Store Atre Akihabara from April 17 to November 23, 2026. The event features newly commissioned illustration merchandise and mini-games, with character-specific campaigns rolling out in sequence.
en.content:
## Overview

The "Gintama Chara Pop Store" is being held at Bandai Namco Cross Store Atre Akihabara. The event runs from April 17 to November 23, 2026, at Chara Pop Store Branch 2 on the 2nd floor of Atre Akihabara 1.

The concept for this event is "Shippuu Doto" (Storm and Fury). Newly commissioned illustrations of Gintoki Sakata, Toshiro Hijikata, Sougo Okita, Kotaro Katsura, Shinsuke Takasugi, and Kamui will be rolled out in character-specific campaigns.

## Highlights

At the venue, original goods using newly commissioned and mini-character illustrations are available, including acrylic stands, tapestries, can badge sets, acrylic objects, and tag keychains.

A mini-game called "Gintama Garapon" also lets you win original prizes. Each play costs ¥660 (tax included), with prizes such as acrylic boards, square can badges, and die-cut stickers.

The schedule for each character campaign is as follows: Hijikata Festival through May 11; Kamui Festival from May 12 to June 5; Katsura Festival from June 6 to June 29; Okita Festival from June 30 to July 29; Takasugi Festival from July 30 to September 2; Gintoki Festival from September 3 to October 12; and a Grand Finale from October 13 to November 23.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Bandai Namco Cross Store Atre Akihabara
- **Address**: Chara Pop Store Branch 2, 2F Atre Akihabara 1, 1-17-6 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: April 17 – November 23, 2026
- **Hours**: 10:00–21:00
- **Contents**: Original merchandise, mini-game, purchase bonuses
- **Admission**: Free (merchandise and mini-games sold separately; Garapon ¥660/play)
- **Reservation**: Entry restrictions may apply during busy periods

## Recommended For

- Those who want to collect newly commissioned "Gintama" merchandise
- Those who enjoy Chara Pop Store exclusive mini-games
- Those looking for a long-running character event at Atre Akihabara
- Those who want to follow each character's dedicated campaign

en.title: [Akihabara] First Cabin Akihabara Reopens on June 1
en.summary: The compact hotel "First Cabin Akihabara", which had been closed, will reopen on June 1, 2026. Reservations open on the official website from May 1, with a 14-night stay plan also available.
en.content:
## Overview

The compact hotel "First Cabin Akihabara", which had been closed, will reopen on June 1, 2026.

The facility has been renamed from "First Cabin Akihabara Showa-dori" to "First Cabin Akihabara," with reservations opening on the official website from May 1, 2026.

## Highlights

First Cabin Akihabara is a compact hotel in the Akihabara area that had been closed since 2021. The reopening includes partial renovation of facilities, cleaning and maintenance, and a review of services.

The property offers a lobby lounge, powder room, shower booths, and a large communal bath, with separate male and female floors. The coin laundry has been expanded from 2 to 5 units, making it well-suited for extended stays and business travel.

As an opening celebration, a 14-night stay plan exclusive to official website members is also available. The hotel positions itself as a convenient base for work, sightseeing, or fan activities centered around Akihabara.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: First Cabin Akihabara
- **Address**: 38 Kanda Sakumacho 3-chome, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Opening date**: June 1, 2026
- **Capacity**: 149 cabins
- **Facilities**: Lobby lounge, powder room, shower booths, communal bath, and more
- **Price**: Check official website or booking sites
- **Reservation**: Accepting reservations on the official website

## Recommended For

- Those looking for accommodation near Akihabara Station
- Fans wanting a home base for events and activities
- Those looking for a compact hotel suitable for extended stays

summary: VRユーザー、VRクリエイター、VR関連企業が集まる『超メタフェス2026』が、2026年5月23日に秋葉原UDXで開催。即売会、企業展示、VRChat公式出展、ステージ、夜の懇親会を展開する。
content:
## 概要

VRユーザー、VRクリエイター、VR関連企業の交流イベント『超メタフェス2026』が、2026年5月23日に秋葉原UDXで開催されます。会場は秋葉原UDX 2階 アキバ・スクエア、4階 UDXギャラリー、4階 UDXギャラリーネクストです。

昼の部は一般参加無料で、VRChatで活動するクリエイターの即売会、VR関連企業の展示・体験会、ステージイベントなどを実施。夜の部では事前申込制の懇親会も予定されています。

## 内容

2階アキバ・スクエアでは、VRChatで活躍するクリエイターによる即売会を開催。約130スペースに拡大し、退出時には先着でVRChatアバターステッカーやJINGO先生描き下ろしイラストクリアファイルの配布も案内されています。

4階UDXギャラリーでは、VRデバイスやクリエイター支援サービスなどの企業展示を実施。VRChat Inc.の出展、VRChat運営と交流できるコーナー、VRChat Inc.などによるステージイベントも予定されています。ラウンジエリアを利用できる有料チケット『超メタフェスPlus』や、夜の懇親会も用意されます。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: 秋葉原UDX 2F アキバ・スクエア / 4F UDXギャラリー / 4F UDXギャラリーネクスト
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区外神田4-14-1
- **日程**: 2026年5月23日
- **時間**: 昼の部 11:00〜16:00（企業展示エリア・交流エリアは17:00まで） / 夜の部 17:30〜20:30
- **料金**: 昼の部は無料（ラウンジエリアのみ有料）、夜の部は5,500円（税込）
- **予約**: 一般参加は事前申込が必要。申込にはVRChat IDが必要

## こんな人におすすめ

- VRChatやメタバース文化のリアルイベントに参加したい方
- VRクリエイターの即売会を巡りたい方

- 秋葉原UDXで開催される大型交流イベントを探している方

en.title: [Akihabara] VR Community Event "Chometa Fes 2026" at Akihabara UDX
en.summary: "Chometa Fes 2026", an event bringing together VR users, VR creators, and VR-related companies, will be held at Akihabara UDX on May 23, 2026. It features a creator market, company exhibits, an official VRChat booth, stage events, and an evening meetup.
en.content:
## Overview

"Chometa Fes 2026", a community event for VR users, VR creators, and VR-related companies, will be held at Akihabara UDX on May 23, 2026. The venues are Akiba Square on the 2nd floor, UDX Gallery on the 4th floor, and UDX Gallery Next on the 4th floor.

The daytime program is free for general attendees and includes a creator market by VRChat creators, VR-related company exhibits and demos, and stage events. An evening meetup requiring advance registration is also planned.

## Highlights

At Akiba Square on the 2nd floor, a creator market featuring VRChat creators will be held. The area has expanded to about 130 spaces, and visitors leaving the 2nd-floor market will receive VRChat avatar stickers and a JINGO illustrated clear file while supplies last.

On the 4th floor at UDX Gallery, companies will exhibit VR devices and creator support services. VRChat Inc. will also exhibit, with a corner where visitors can meet VRChat staff and stage events by VRChat Inc. and others. Paid "Chometa Fes Plus" tickets for lounge access and an evening meetup are also available.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Akihabara UDX 2F Akiba Square / 4F UDX Gallery / 4F UDX Gallery Next
- **Address**: 4-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Date**: May 23, 2026
- **Hours**: Daytime 11:00–16:00 (company exhibit and exchange areas until 17:00) / Evening 17:30–20:30
- **Admission**: Daytime free (lounge area paid only); evening meetup ¥5,500 (tax included)
- **Reservation**: Advance registration is required for general attendees. A VRChat ID is required to apply

## Recommended For

- Those who want to join an in-person VRChat or metaverse culture event
- Those interested in a VR creator market
- Those who want to try the latest VR devices and tracking equipment
- Those looking for a large community event at Akihabara UDX

en.summary: "Analog Audio Fair 2026", an exhibition and sales event for analog audio equipment and record-related products, will be held at Sonpo Kaikan in Akihabara on May 30 and 31, 2026. Admission is ¥500 and valid for both days; students and visitors age 30 or younger can enter free with proof.
en.content:
## Overview

"Analog Audio Fair 2026", an exhibition and sales event for analog audio equipment, accessories, and record-related products, will be held at Sonpo Kaikan in Akihabara on May 30 and 31, 2026.

The venue is Sonpo Kaikan at 2-9 Kanda Awajicho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. It is about a five-minute walk from JR Akihabara Station's Electric Town Exit and JR Ochanomizu Station's Hijiribashi Exit.

## Highlights

The official site introduces the fair as an event created to help people continue enjoying high-quality analog record playback and to introduce analog audio to a wider audience. It is aimed at visitors interested in analog players, cartridges, related accessories, records, and similar products.

Admission is ¥500 (tax included) and valid for both days. Students can enter free by showing a student ID, and visitors age 30 or younger can enter free by showing proof of age. PHILE WEB also describes the event as an opportunity to see analog playback brands and enjoy listening comparisons.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Sonpo Kaikan, Akihabara
- **Address**: 2-9 Kanda Awajicho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: May 30–31, 2026
- **Hours**: May 30, 12:00–19:00 / May 31, 10:00–18:00
- **Admission**: ¥500 (tax included, valid for both days); free for students and visitors age 30 or younger with proof
- **Reservation**: No advance reservation is listed on the official site

## Recommended For

- Fans of analog records and audio equipment
- Those who want to compare players, cartridges, and accessories
- Those looking for a weekend exhibition around Akihabara and Ochanomizu
- Students and visitors age 30 or younger who can attend free and experience audio gear

title: BEEP秋葉原店が5月17日で一時閉店、SEEKBASEへ移転準備
summary: レトロゲーム・レトロPC専門店「BEEP秋葉原店」が、2026年5月17日をもって現店舗での営業を一時終了。中栄ビル取り壊しに伴い、SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTUREへの移転準備に入る。
content:
## 概要

レトロゲームやレトロPCを扱う「BEEP秋葉原店」が、2026年5月17日をもって現店舗での営業を一時終了します。

現店舗は東京都千代田区外神田3-9-8 中栄ビル地下1階。2015年10月のオープンから約10年半営業してきた店舗ですが、入居する中栄ビルの取り壊しに伴い、移転準備のため一時閉店となります。

## 内容

移転先は、神田消防署向かいの「SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE」3号棟。エルミタージュ秋葉原の現地取材では、2月末に閉店した日本郵政のギフトショップ「SOZO BOX」跡地にあたり、新店舗側にはすでに看板も設置されていると報じられています。

BEEP秋葉原店の公式ブログでは、5月18日以降、新店舗オープンまで営業を休止し、販売、買取、修理、問い合わせなどの業務も休止すると案内されています。店頭買取は5月11日から16日まで15:00受付終了、最終日の5月17日は終日休止です。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: BEEP秋葉原店
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区外神田3-9-8 中栄ビル B1F
- **現店舗最終営業日**: 2026年5月17日
- **移転先**: SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE 3号棟
- **移転先住所**: 東京都千代田区神田練塀町15-1
- **内容**: 現店舗一時閉店、移転準備、さよならセール、店頭買取受付時間変更
- **料金**: 入場無料（商品購入は別途）
- **予約**: 不要

## こんな人におすすめ

- BEEP秋葉原店の現店舗を最後に訪れたい方
- レトロゲームやレトロPC関連ショップの移転情報を追っている方

en.title: [Akihabara] BEEP Akihabara Temporarily Closes on May 17 Before Moving to SEEKBASE
en.summary: Retro game and retro PC specialty shop BEEP Akihabara will temporarily end operations at its current location on May 17, 2026. The shop is preparing to move to SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE due to the demolition of the Chuei Building.
en.content:
## Overview

BEEP Akihabara, a specialty shop for retro games and retro PCs, will temporarily end operations at its current location on May 17, 2026.

The current shop is located in the basement of the Chuei Building at 3-9-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. After about ten and a half years since opening in October 2015, the shop will temporarily close because the building is being demolished and the store is preparing to move.

## Highlights

The new location is in SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE Building 3, across from the Kanda Fire Station. Hermitage Akihabara reports that it will occupy the former SOZO BOX space, and signage has already been installed at the new site.

BEEP Akihabara's official blog says that from May 18 onward, all sales, buying, repairs, and inquiries will be paused until the new store opens. In-store buying closes at 15:00 from May 11 to May 16, and is suspended all day on the final day, May 17.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: BEEP Akihabara
- **Address**: Chuei Building B1F, 3-9-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Final Day at Current Store**: May 17, 2026
- **New Location**: SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE Building 3
- **New Address**: 15-1 Kanda Neribeicho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Contents**: Temporary closure of the current store, relocation preparation, farewell sale, and changes to in-store buying hours
- **Admission**: Free (merchandise sold separately)
- **Reservation**: Not required

## Recommended For

- Those who want to visit BEEP Akihabara's current shop before it closes
- Fans tracking retro game and retro PC shop relocation news
- Visitors checking new openings and moves around SEEKBASE
- Anyone documenting changes in Akihabara's specialty shop scene

en.content:
## Overview

The Japan Hacker Association will hold the cybersecurity conference "Hack Fes. 2026" at Akihabara UDX on July 18, 2026.

## Highlights

The first program announcement includes talks on cyber offense and defense, space cybersecurity, AI-powered 0-day discovery, quantum-resistant cryptography, and countermeasures against fake news.

Workshops include "Tokumaru Book Update 2026" and "Introduction to Bug Hunting in the AI Era". Tickets went on sale via Peatix on May 13, 2026. A networking party is also planned after the conference.

## Recommended For

- Visitors looking for technology conferences held at Akihabara UDX

title: 怪談師・城谷歩 独演会「全心全霊 Vol.5」が秋葉原UDXシアターで開催
summary: 怪談師・城谷歩の独演会「全心全霊 Vol.5 城谷節の真骨頂 〜怪怖涙談〜」が、2026年7月24日・25日に秋葉原UDXシアターで開催。3公演構成で、ゲストに薩摩琵琶奏者の丸山恭司が出演する。
content:
## 概要

怪談師・城谷歩の独演会「全心全霊 Vol.5 城谷節の真骨頂 〜怪怖涙談〜」が、2026年7月24日と25日に秋葉原UDXシアターで開催されます。

今年のテーマは「怪怖涙談」。怪談の怪しさ、恐怖、涙を誘う要素を、城谷歩の語りと劇場演出で届ける怪談エンタテインメント公演です。

## 内容

公演は全3回で、7月24日19:00、7月25日13:00、7月25日18:00に実施予定。各公演で異なる怪談話を披露すると案内されています。

第二部では、薩摩琵琶奏者の丸山恭司と共演する古典怪談の演目も予定。会場では新作Tシャツ、手ぬぐい、フォトブック、ステッカーセット、アクリルスタンドなどの公演グッズも販売されます。チケットは2026年5月7日10:00からチケットペイで販売開始です。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: 秋葉原UDXシアター
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区外神田4-14-1 秋葉原UDX 4F
- **日程**: 2026年7月24日〜7月25日
- **時間**: 7月24日19:00 / 7月25日13:00・18:00
- **出演**: 城谷歩
- **ゲスト**: 丸山恭司（薩摩琵琶奏者）
- **内容**: 怪談独演会、古典怪談演目、公演グッズ販売
- **料金**: 5,000円
- **予約**: チケットペイで販売

## こんな人におすすめ

- 城谷歩の怪談公演を劇場で楽しみたい方
- 秋葉原UDXシアターの演劇・ライブ系イベントを探している方
- 音響、照明、映像を使った怪談エンタテインメントに興味がある方
- 夏の怪談イベントを早めに押さえたい方

en.title: [Akihabara] Storyteller Ayumu Shirotani Solo Show "Zenshin Zenrei Vol.5" at Akihabara UDX Theater
en.summary: Kaidan storyteller Ayumu Shirotani's solo show "Zenshin Zenrei Vol.5: The Essence of Shirotani-bushi - Kaifu Ruidan" will be held at Akihabara UDX Theater on July 24 and 25, 2026. The three-performance event features Satsuma biwa player Kyoji Maruyama as guest.
en.content:
## Overview

Kaidan storyteller Ayumu Shirotani's solo show "Zenshin Zenrei Vol.5: The Essence of Shirotani-bushi - Kaifu Ruidan" will be held at Akihabara UDX Theater on July 24 and 25, 2026.

This year's theme is "Kaifu Ruidan". The show presents the eerie, frightening, and tearful elements of kaidan through Shirotani's narration and theater production.

## Highlights

The event consists of three performances: July 24 at 19:00, July 25 at 13:00, and July 25 at 18:00. Each performance is planned to feature different kaidan stories.

The second part will include a classical kaidan piece performed with Satsuma biwa player Kyoji Maruyama. Event merchandise such as new T-shirts, tenugui towels, photo books, sticker sets, and acrylic stands will also be sold at the venue. Tickets went on sale via TicketPay at 10:00 on May 7, 2026.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Akihabara UDX Theater
- **Address**: Akihabara UDX 4F, 4-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: July 24–25, 2026
- **Times**: July 24 at 19:00 / July 25 at 13:00 and 18:00
- **Performer**: Ayumu Shirotani
- **Guest**: Kyoji Maruyama (Satsuma biwa player)
- **Contents**: Kaidan solo show, classical kaidan piece, event merchandise sales
- **Admission**: ¥5,000
- **Reservation**: Tickets sold via TicketPay

## Recommended For

- Those who want to experience Ayumu Shirotani's kaidan performance in a theater
- Visitors looking for theater and live events at Akihabara UDX Theater
- Those interested in kaidan entertainment using sound, lighting, and visuals
- Fans who want to secure tickets early for a summer kaidan event
